lines.en: The manor grounds are eerily quiet today.
lines.zh: 公馆的场地今天安静得诡异。

lines.en: Normally, you’ll catch passing glimpses of gardeners, security workers, or whatever other sort of people the grossly wealthy typically employ.
lines.zh: 平常,你总能瞥见园丁、保安,或者巨富之流通常雇佣的其他什么人。

lines.en: Today, there’s no one — just Tsubasa and me as I’m led through building after building and eventually up into some tower I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: 今天,一个人也没有——只有 Tsubasa 和我,被她领着穿过一栋又一栋楼,最终上到某座我从未见过的塔里。

lines.en: It overlooks this entire kingdom of opulence and reminds me that I, too, am naught but one more expendable worker bee in her extravagant hive of forced employment.
lines.zh: 它俯瞰着这片奢华的整个王国,并提醒我:我也不过是她那座强迫劳役的奢华蜂巢里,又一只可有可无的工蜂。

lines.en: The termite queen would never. Her soldiers are the type to clean her out of love, not because they’re shackled to stakes beside her undulating white flesh-mass.
lines.zh: 白蚁蚁后就绝不会。她的兵蚁清理蚁穴是出于爱,而不是因为被锁在她那团起伏的白色肉块旁边的木桩上。

lines.en: Yet, the rewards those soldiers reap would be just that. And thoughts of greater wealth or ascendence would be little more than flashes in the same pan that will, one day, be used to cook them and serve them up to guests.
lines.zh: 然而,那些兵蚁收获的回报恰恰就是那种。而对更多财富、更高地位的幻想,不过是同一口锅里的转瞬火花——那口锅终有一天会用来烹煮它们、端给宾客。

lines.en: If I do as she says-
lines.zh: 如果我照她说的做——

lines.en: If I dance on her strings and let her get what she wants-
lines.zh: 如果我在她的提线上起舞、让她得偿所愿——

lines.en: Surely I will be a very rich man. Surely.
lines.zh: 我必将是非常富有的人。必将。

lines.en: But, in the event I am not when I do-
lines.zh: 但如果我做了、却不是——

lines.en: I hope that those who feast upon this body think of me as the human equivalent of the finest veal money can buy — with meat so tender from never exploring what’s outside of my cage.
lines.zh: 我希望,享用这具身体的人把我当作钱能买到的最高级小牛肉的人类等价物——肉那么嫩,因为我从未探索过笼子外面的世界。

lines.en: These legs weren’t made for walking. They were meant to go limp and fold the moment the gates open.
lines.zh: 这双腿不是用走路的。它们生来就该在大门开启的那一刻软下去、折起来。

lines.en: : Allow me to introduce you to my own personal Heaven. Tyranny is so much easier in the bath with a nice merlot, you see.
lines.zh: : 请容我向你介绍我私人的天堂。你知道吗,泡着澡、配上一杯上好的梅洛,施行暴政要容易得多。

lines.en: : Thank you for the impromptu spa trip. I think I’d have preferred that onsen from a few years back though since I wouldn’t feel as imprisoned there.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你安排这次临时水疗。不过我想我更喜欢几年前的那个温泉——在那儿我不会感觉像坐牢。

lines.en: : You can leave any time you like, Akira.
lines.zh: : 你随时都可以走,Akira。

lines.en: : Awesome. Then I will leave right now.
lines.zh: : 好极了。那我现在就走。

lines.en: : Fine. Just know that, by doing so, you’ll be missing out on finally seeing me in the nude.
lines.zh: : 好吧。只是要知道,你这么做,将错过终于看到我裸体的机会。

lines.en: : God fucking damn it.
lines.zh: : 老天他娘的。

lines.en: : Hahah! Oh, if only Touka was that easy to tempt into coming here. She’s starting to catch on to this place being my throne room and has been somewhat hesitant to bathe with me as of late.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!唉,要是 Touka 也这么容易哄来这里就好了。她开始察觉这里是王座厅,最近都不太愿意和我共浴了。

lines.en: : So we’re bathing together? That’s what’s going on here? I can totally see how such a thing will enrich your family’s future. It all makes sense now.
lines.zh: : 所以我们要一起洗澡?这就是这里要发生的事?我完全看得出这种事会如何丰富你家族的未来。全都通了。

lines.en: : You’re sounding awfully sarcastic for someone about to see what very few have, Akira. Perhaps I could entice you more if I was still battling puberty?
lines.zh: : 对于一个即将见到极少数人才能见到之物的人来说,你的口气相当讥诮啊,Akira。也许我要是还在与青春期搏斗,更能勾起你的兴趣?

lines.en: : Touka’s going to kill you for this, you know. She’s more fed up with your antics than even I am.
lines.zh: : 你知道吧,Touka 会为这事杀了你。她比我还受不了你的胡闹。

lines.en: : How about we just forget she even exists from now until the end of the night? I love her dearly, but it’d hurt my feelings oh so badly if you were to be thinking of her while I’m fully exposed.
lines.zh: : 不如从现在到今晚结束,我们都忘了她的存在?我深爱着她,但如果我一丝不挂时你心里想的却是她,我的感情会痛得不得了。

lines.en: : No it wouldn’t. Knowing you and how willing you are to sacrifice your daughters to me, I’m not convinced you wouldn’t be whispering into my ear and asking me to tell you about my very many fantasies of her.
lines.zh: : 不会痛。了解你,了解你多愿意把女儿们献祭给我,我不信你不会凑到我耳边,要我把关于她的种种幻想讲给你听。

lines.en: : Well, you didn’t have to make it sound so fun.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你也不必把它说得这么好玩。

lines.en: : So what’s the goal here? How do you spin a co-ed bathing session into something that makes your life easier? Because we both know this isn’t just some booty call.
lines.zh: : 所以这里的目标是什么?你怎么把一场男女共浴变成让你人生更轻松的东西?因为我们都知道,这不只是个炮约。

lines.en: : Do we? For all you know, I brought you up here to fuck me raw in the only place I can get some true privacy.
lines.zh: : 都知道吗?说不定我把你带上来,就是想在这唯一能获得真正隐私的地方,让我被你生猛地干。

lines.en: : It’s been ages for me, you know. I imagine you’d have no trouble at all making me whine and whimper with a skill-set like yours. I wouldn’t seem so scary then, would I?
lines.zh: : 我已经荒废了很久,你知道吗。以你那套本事,我想你让我哀鸣呜咽毫无难度。那时我就没那么可怕了,对吧?

lines.en: : I’ve seen porn like this. Where a woman’s not being adequately loved and so she steals her daughter’s boyfriend instead.
lines.zh: : 我看过这种片。一个女人得不到足够的爱,于是偷走女儿的男朋友。

lines.en: : Tell me more. It might help me get into character.
lines.zh: : 多讲讲。也许能帮我进入角色。

lines.en: : Take your clothes off if you want me to fuck you.
lines.zh: : 想让我上你,就把衣服脱了。

lines.en: : Right now? You don’t intend to skip foreplay, do you? Because I’m one thing, but my girls deserve to be treated much better than that.
lines.zh: : 现在?你不打算跳过前戏吧?我是一回事,但我的女儿们值得更好的对待。

lines.en: : Girl. Only one of them is on my radar. No matter how badly you want me to break the other one.
lines.zh: : 一个。我的雷达上只有她们中的一个。无论你多想让我毁掉另一个。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that. Could I ask you to close your eyes for a moment?
lines.zh: : 那走着瞧。能否请你闭一会儿眼睛?

lines.en: : No.
: Oh.
: I guess I’ll just have to take matters into my own hands then! Enjoy your new home, Akira! I’ll let you out sometime today if you be a good boy!
lines.zh: : 那我只好亲自动手了!享受你的新家吧,Akira!你乖乖的话,今天晚些时候就放你出来!

lines.en: : Wha- I knew I should have been suspicious about this locker! What do you think you’re doing?! And why are you so strong?!
lines.zh: : 什——我就知道该提防这个更衣柜!你想干什么?!而且你哪来这么大力气?!

lines.en: : Have you never heard of hysterical strength before? It’s a relatively common occurrence in mothers suddenly thrown into life-threatening scenarios where adrenaline runs high and suppresses a body’s safety inhibitors.
lines.zh: : 你没听说过歇斯底里神力吗?这在突然被抛入危及生命情境的母亲身上相当常见——肾上腺素飙升,抑制了身体的自我保护机制。

lines.en: : The analogy typically used involves lifting a car, though. And, with all due respect Akira, you’re not that big. Now, in you go. Hurry up.
lines.zh: : 通常的类比是抬起一辆汽车。而且恕我直言,Akira,你没那么大块头。好,进去吧。快点。

lines.en: : I...Tsubasa, this might not be the time, but I kind of have a thing with being forced into dark, enclosed spaces that I don’t really want to-
lines.zh: : 我……Tsubasa,现在说这个可能不合时宜,但我有点……不太想被强制关进黑暗的密闭空间——

lines.en: : Grin and bear with it. You’re Japanese, aren’t you? 我慢して! Your reward is right around the corner!
lines.zh: : 忍着吧。你是日本人,不是吗?我慢して!你的奖励就在拐角处!

lines.en: : I still don’t-
lines.zh: : 我还是不——

lines.en: : I said 我慢して you stubborn brat!
lines.zh: : 我说了我慢して,你这个倔小鬼!

lines.en: : Tsubasa! Let me out of here! What the fuck is wrong with you?!
lines.zh: : Tsubasa!放我出去!你他妈有毛病吗?!

lines.en: : Ah-ah-ah! Yelling will only get you in trouble, Aki-kun! Besides, I need to go undress. The moisture in the air here is already being quite unkind to my clothes.
lines.zh: : 哎哎哎!大喊大叫只会让你惹上麻烦,Aki 君!再说,我得去脱衣服。这里的湿气已经对我的衣服相当不客气了。

lines.en: : I don’t give a shit about your clothes! I-
lines.zh: : 谁管你的衣服!我——

lines.en: : Akira, calm down. You are safe here. You have my word.
lines.zh: : Akira,冷静。你在这里是安全的。我向你保证。

lines.en: : Your word doesn’t mean anything when you’ve told me a thousand times that you just say shit...
lines.zh: : 你都说过一千遍你只是随口说说,你的保证还有什么意义……

lines.en: : Hmmmmm? Did you say something, Akira? I’m sorry, but it’s just so hard to hear you in there.
lines.zh: : 嗯————?你说什么了吗,Akira?抱歉,你在里面说话实在听不清。

lines.en: : Forget it...
lines.zh: : 算了……

lines.en: : I just need to...close my eyes...
lines.zh: : 我只需要……闭上眼睛……

lines.en: There used to be a game I’d play when I was locked in the closet.
lines.zh: 从前我被关进壁橱时,有个我会玩的游戏。

lines.en: I’d count. From one up to whatever number I stopped at.
lines.zh: 我会数数。从一开始,数到某个我停下的数字。

lines.en: That was it.
lines.zh: 就这样。

lines.en: And it wasn’t very fun, no. But it helped distract me from all of the sounds on the other side of the door.
lines.zh: 并不好玩,是的。但它能帮我分散注意力,不去听门那边的种种声音。

lines.en: The screaming. The moaning. The sound of the bed creaking and the headboard slamming against the wall.
lines.zh: 尖叫。呻吟。床架吱呀作响,床头板撞击墙壁。

lines.en: I realized back then, perhaps even before then, that this was something people did to quell their raging feelings at times.
lines.zh: 那时我就意识到,也许更早,这就是人们有时用来镇压翻腾情感的东西。

lines.en: And I used to wonder when I, too, would have an outlet like that. Something to make the feelings stop.
lines.zh: 而我曾常常想,我什么时候也会有一个那样的出口。能让那些感情停下的东西。

lines.en: And then I did.
lines.zh: 然后我有了。

lines.en: And then they didn’t.
lines.zh: 然后那些感情没有停。

lines.en: And now here I am again — right where I left off. A neglected animal with no one left to give me water.
lines.zh: 而现在,我又回到了这里——正好停在当初停下的地方。一只被遗忘的动物,再没有人给我水喝。

lines.en: This cage will not unlock again.
lines.zh: 这只笼子不会再打开了。

lines.en: I watch her shower. She’s just as beautiful as I expected her to be. And it’s no mystery why Touka is the same.
lines.zh: 我看着她淋浴。她美得正如我的预想。Touka 会一样美,也不成谜。

lines.en: She acknowledges my presence, glancing through the slits in the locker with a half-smile every thirty seconds or so to remind me that I’m not forgotten. But she never speaks.
lines.zh: 她注意到我在,每隔三十秒左右,便透过柜门的缝隙投来半抹微笑,提醒我她没忘了我。但她从不说话。

lines.en: And that is good. Because animals do not talk. And I don’t want to be tempted into thinking I’m more than I am.
lines.zh: 那样很好。因为动物不说话。而我不想被诱惑,以为我比实际更高一等。

lines.en: The shower turns off and the water stops right away. When mine turns off, it keeps on dripping for a while.
lines.zh: 她的淋浴一关,水立刻停了。我的关掉后,还要滴上一阵。

lines.en: She stands up and looks at me. Then says this-
lines.zh: 她站起身,看着我。然后说——

lines.en: : I need you to promise me you aren’t going to try and come out of there. Do you understand? It’ll look very bad for me if I need to hire a locksmith to pry that thing open if you damage the lock.
lines.zh: : 我要你向我保证,你不会试图从里面出来。明白吗?你要是弄坏了锁,害我雇开锁匠来撬,那太难看了。

lines.en: : Other than that, feel free to stare to your heart’s content. Stroke yourself if you like. Just don’t make any noise or you might scare Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 除此之外,尽管看个够。想自我安抚也随你。只是别出声,免得吓到 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : You can make noise now. She’s not here yet, silly.
lines.zh: : 现在可以出声了。她还没到呢,傻孩子。

lines.en: : Tsukasa is coming?...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 要来?……

lines.en: : Well, duh. You think I’d lock you up and force you to watch me bathe? I get nothing from that. This is practically a sales pitch. So sit back and enjoy the presentation, would you?
lines.zh: : 废话。你以为我锁你进来,是逼你看我洗澡?那样我什么都得不到。这实际上是一场推销。所以请坐好,欣赏演示,行吗?

lines.en: : Oh! And no recording either! I just realized I forgot to take your phone!
lines.zh: : 哦!也不许录像!我刚意识到忘了收你的手机!

lines.en: : We don’t want Touka catching you beating your cock to pictures of her family, do we? She’s still your number one. For now, at least.
lines.zh: : 可不能让 Touka 抓到你对着她家人的照片撸,对吧?她还是你的头号。至少目前是。

lines.en: : But who’s to say that doesn’t change after today? After you see with your own eyes just what and who you’re missing out on.
lines.zh: : 但谁说今天过后不会变呢?等你亲眼看到,你正在错过什么人、错过什么。

lines.en: : Mother? May...I enter?
lines.zh: : 母亲?我……可以进来吗?

lines.en: : Claim her, and you may have me as well. Together, if that’s what it takes.
lines.zh: : 占有她,我也可以给你。一起也行,只要那是代价。

lines.en: : What?...
: Shh...It’s time to be a good boy again...
lines.zh: : 嘘……该重新当个乖孩子了……

lines.en: : I...I’m here. You wanted to...see me about something?
lines.zh: : 我……我来了。您有……想见我谈的事?

lines.en: : Why do you look so nervous, dear? Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 你怎么这么紧张,亲爱的?出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : No, it’s just...you don’t...normally let me in this room. This is where you and Onee-sama talk about...whatever it is you two talk about in here.
lines.zh: : 没有,只是……您平时……不让我进这个房间。这是您和 Onee-sama 谈……你们在这里谈的那些事的地方。

lines.en: : You’re my daughter as well, Tsukasa. And today, I want to talk to you. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 你也是我的女儿,Tsukasa。今天,我想和你谈谈。可以吗?

lines.en: : About what? I’m not in trouble, am I? I haven’t even fired anybody this week.
lines.zh: : 谈什么?我没惹麻烦吧?我这周连人都没开除。

lines.en: : Tsukasa dear, come bathe with me. Let’s just relax today. There’s no need to talk about firing or anything related to the family. Enjoy the scenery. Come look out at our kingdom.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 亲爱的,来和我一起泡澡吧。今天就放松放松。不用谈开除,也不用谈任何和家族有关的事。欣赏风景。来看看我们的王国。

lines.en: : I do love kingdoms. And the view from here is nicer than it is from my building...I’m just afraid I’ll annoy you again.
lines.zh: : 我确实喜欢王国。而且从这里看的风景比从我的楼里好……我只是怕又会惹您烦。

lines.en: : You don’t annoy me, Tsukasa. I’m just very busy sometimes and can’t spare you the affection you need. Which is why-
lines.zh: : 你不会惹我烦,Tsukasa。只是我有时非常忙,匀不出你需要的关爱。正因为如此——

lines.en: : Apologies for interrupting, Mother, but this locker seems very out of place and suspicious. As prime targets for assassination, this is something we should be vigilant about. Shall I call the guards to check?
lines.zh: : 打扰了,母亲,但这个更衣柜看起来非常突兀可疑。作为暗杀的头号目标,这类事我们应当警惕。要我叫保安来查吗?

lines.en: : Uh...no. I’ve already done that, darling. Just take your towel off and bathe with me. Before something tries to pull me away again.
lines.zh: : 呃……不用。我已经查过了,亲爱的。快解开浴巾,和我一起泡。趁还没什么东西又想把我拉走。

lines.en: : Mm...I feel like you’re always getting pulled away these days. And it’s not like Onee-sama wants to spend time with me either.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得您这些天总是被拉走。而 Onee-sama 也不想和我共度时光。

lines.en: : Are you feeling lonely, dear?
lines.zh: : 你觉得孤独了吗,亲爱的?

lines.en: : No, I’m fine. I have Chinami. And everyone else is busy, so I need to keep doing my part and not getting in the way of anything.
lines.zh: : 不,我没事。我有 Chinami。其他人都在忙,所以我得继续做好我的份内事,不碍任何人的事。

lines.en: : Are the two of you still studying together? And how is Chika? I feel like it’s been ages since I’ve last seen her.
lines.zh: : 你们俩还在一起学习吗?Chika 怎么样?我总觉得已经很久没见过她了。

lines.en: : I don’t know, actually. Sometimes she’s really nice and other times, she looks like she’s going to jump off a skyscraper. She’s always holding a knife too. I don’t get it. Like, it’s literally all the time.
lines.zh: : 其实我也不知道。有时她人特别好,有时她又像要跳楼一样。她还总是拿着刀。我不懂。就是,真的每时每刻。

lines.en: : Teenagers are quite temperamental. That’s likely why your sister hasn’t had much time for you either.
lines.zh: : 青少年情绪起伏很大。你姐姐没多少时间给你,多半也是这个原因。

lines.en: : No, Onee-sama is just always with her weird friend now. And when it’s not her, it’s Jeeves- which means I can’t really see him either.
lines.zh: : 不,Onee-sama 只是总和她那个怪朋友在一起。不是她的时候,就是 Jeeves——也就是说我也见不到他。

lines.en: : Stop calling him Jeeves, dear. His name is Akira. If you want to have an actual relationship with him, that’s a good place to start.
lines.zh: : 别再叫他 Jeeves 了,亲爱的。他的名字是 Akira。你要想和他有真正的关系,从这一点开始比较好。

lines.en: : He doesn’t want me to call him that. I don’t think he even likes me. He seems annoyed any time I try to have him teach me about stuff.
lines.zh: : 他不想让我那么叫。我觉得他连喜欢我都谈不上。每次我让他教我东西,他好像都很烦。

lines.en: : Besides, wouldn’t calling him by his name just make it like how it was when I had a rabbit? I’d get attached and be more upset when he stops coming to see me.
lines.zh: : 再说,叫他的名字,不就变得和我养兔子的那次一样了吗?我会产生感情,等他不再来看我时,会更难过。

lines.en: : Oh, Tsukasa...Akira will be in our family for a long time. He’s not leaving us any time soon.
lines.zh: : 哦,Tsukasa……Akira 会在我们家很久。他不会很快就离开我们。

lines.en: : Yeah, but if he does, it’ll be because Onee-sama purchased the rights to his existence and decided to marry him. And she’ll ban me from seeing him altogether if that happens.
lines.zh: : 是,可万一他离开,那也会是因为 Onee-sama 买下了他存在的权利、决定嫁给他。而真到那时,她会彻底禁止我见他。

lines.en: : Aww...you’re scared, aren’t you? That your first ever crush won’t go anywhere.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……你害怕了,是吧?怕你的初恋心动不会有结果。

lines.en: : Crush?
lines.zh: : 心动?

lines.en: : It’s the word for when you really like someone and want to spend more time with them.
lines.zh: : 就是很喜欢某个人、想和他共度更多时光时用的那个词。

lines.en: : Oh. Like you and that Yuki lady?
lines.zh: : 哦。像您和那位 Yuki 小姐?

lines.en: : That...uh...no. No, Yuki and I are just friends. We-
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……不。不,Yuki 和我只是朋友。我们——

lines.en: : You must be really good friends then with the way you stare at her. If Chinami stared at me like that, I’d think she got infected with something.
lines.zh: : 那你们一定是非常要好的朋友,瞧您盯着她的眼神。Chinami 要是那么盯着我,我会以为她感染了什么。

lines.en: : Ahem. We...are very good friends, Tsukasa. Yuki and I have known each other for longer than you’ve been alive. But we’re not talking about her right now. We’re talking about you and Akira.
lines.zh: : 咳嗯。我们……确实是非常要好的朋友,Tsukasa。Yuki 和我相识的年头比你的岁数还长。但我们现在不谈她。我们谈的是你和 Akira。

lines.en: : I see. Then...do you think I have a crush on him? Does Onee-sama have a crush on him?
lines.zh: : 明白了。那……您觉得我对他心动了吗?Onee-sama 对他心动了吗?

lines.en: : I think you do. But what about you, Tsukasa? How do you feel?
lines.zh: : 我觉得你动心了。可你自己呢,Tsukasa?你怎么想?

lines.en: : Mother? What are...am I in your spot? Why are you-
lines.zh: : 母亲?您在……我在您的位置上吗?您为什么——

lines.en: : Nope! Just getting a little closer to my youngest. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 不是!只是想离我最小的孩子近一点。仅此而已。

lines.en: : Oh...Okay. I don’t think we’ve ever been this close before.
lines.zh: : 哦……好。我想我们从没这么近过。

lines.en: : Not since you were a baby, no. And you’re so big now. Where has the time gone?
lines.zh: : 自你还是婴儿起,确实没有。而你现在都这么大了。时间都去哪了?

lines.en: : I’m still nothing compared to you and Onee-sama. How much longer do you think it’ll take for me to start looking like a woman?
lines.zh: : 和您、和 Onee-sama 相比,我依然什么都不是。您觉得还要多久,我才会开始像个女人?

lines.en: : What’s the rush, dear? You should be cherishing your youth. I never got the chance to do that. So at least try in my stead.
lines.zh: : 急什么,亲爱的?你该珍惜青春。我从未有过机会。所以至少替我试一试。

lines.en: : I don’t like being young...I want people to take me seriously. I want to be able to learn things and do things without people saying I need to wait.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢年轻……我想让人认真对待我。我想学东西、做事情,不用听人说「再等等」。

lines.en: : It’s not fair. Like, that Otoha girl? In Chinami’s sister’s class? She said I’m way more mature than other girls my age. So why am I stuck in that bracket instead of Onee-sama’s?
lines.zh: : 不公平。就比如,那个 Otoha?在 Chinami 的妹妹班上的?她说我比同龄的女孩成熟得多。那为什么我被卡在这个段位,而不是 Onee-sama 的?

lines.en: : Isn’t it important for my education to not be stymied by the perpetual lack of expectation placed upon girls my age wherein every single one of us must first become acquainted with societal norms before we-
lines.zh: : 我的教育不该被强加在我这个年纪女孩身上、那种永恒的低期待所阻碍——我们每个人都得先熟悉社会规范,然后才能——这难道不重要吗?

lines.en: : This doesn’t sound very much like relaxing, dear.
lines.zh: : 这听起来可不太像放松,亲爱的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Mother. I didn’t mean to trouble you with my rambling. I’ll be more careful in the future.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,母亲。我没想用我的碎碎念烦您。以后我会注意的。

lines.en: : I don’t mind your rambling, darling. I just think you’re being too hard on yourself. Nobody needs you to be anything more than you already are.
lines.zh: : 我不介意你的碎碎念,亲爱的。我只是觉得你对自己太苛刻了。没有人需要你变成比你已有的更多的什么。

lines.en: : But what I am isn’t enough...Not for you. Not for Onee-sama. Not for Jeeves. And not...
lines.zh: : 可我现在这样不够……对您不够。对 Onee-sama 不够。对 Jeeves 不够。还有……

lines.en: : And not for my...future husband either...
lines.zh: : 还有对我的……未来丈夫也不够……

lines.en: : You’re still worried about that? You know I met your father that way, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还在担心那个?你知道我就是那样认识你父亲的,对吧?

lines.en: : I know...And I know it’s my duty to do what’s best for the family, so I will. But...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我也知道,为家族做最好的事是我的职责,所以我会做。可是……

lines.en: : I also...
lines.zh: : 我也……

lines.en: : You also what, dear?
lines.zh: : 你也什么,亲爱的?

lines.en: : It’s stupid and immature and unrealistic. Just forget I said anything.
lines.zh: : 愚蠢、幼稚、不切实际。就当我什么都没说。

lines.en: : Say it...Be stupid. Be immature. Be unrealistic. That’s what kids are supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 说出来……犯蠢吧。幼稚吧。不切实际吧。孩子就该这样。

lines.en: : Forget your duty for a minute and just say what you’re thinking. I give you permission.
lines.zh: : 把职责忘掉一分钟,说出你在想什么。我准许你。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I see the way Chinami’s sister looks when she talks about Jeeves. And Onee-sama. And also...his daughter? And they all look so...sure. That he’s the one for them.
lines.zh: : 我看到 Chinami 的妹妹谈起 Jeeves 时的眼神。还有 Onee-sama。还有……他的女儿?她们看起来都那么……笃定。笃定他就是自己的那个人。

lines.en: : I want to feel that way. I want to be sure of something. And I don’t even know what this crush thing is about yet, so how am I supposed to be sure about the man you and father chose for me?
lines.zh: : 我想要那种感觉。我想笃定一件事。可我连「心动」这回事都还没搞懂,又怎么能对您和父亲为我选定的男人笃定?

lines.en: : Do you want someone to look at you the way those girls look at Akira? How would that make you feel, dear?
lines.zh: : 你想要有人用那些女孩看 Akira 的眼神看你吗?那会让你作何感受,亲爱的?

lines.en: : Good...Like I...Like I actually matter to somebody. But nobody’s going to look at me like that the way I am now. I’m just...annoying. And little. Like a...gnat. An annoying, really smart gnat.
lines.zh: : 很好……就像我……就像我真的对某个人有意义。可现在的我,没有人会那样看我。我只是……烦人。又小。像一只……蠓虫。一只烦人的、特别聪明的蠓虫。

lines.en: : Akira doesn’t think you’re a gnat, dear...
lines.zh: : Akira 不觉得你是蠓虫,亲爱的……

lines.en: : In fact, the reason he’s so hesitant to tutor you at all is because he thinks you’re so unbearably adorable that it puts you in danger.
lines.zh: : 实际上,他之所以如此犹豫、连辅导你都不肯,正是因为他觉得你可爱得让人无法忍受,而这会置你于险境。

lines.en: : Danger? Why would I be in danger with Jeeves? He’s always been so nice to me. And yeah, he’s kind of weird. But I’ve never felt in danger at all.
lines.zh: : 危险?我和 Jeeves 在一起会有什么危险?他对我一直都很好。而且对,他是有点怪。但我从来没有感到过危险。

lines.en: : Well, Tsukasa, that’s probably because it’s only dangerous from his perspective.
lines.zh: : 嗯,Tsukasa,那大概是因为,危险的只是他那一侧。

lines.en: : I don’t...I don’t think I get what you mean.
lines.zh: : 我……我不明白您的意思。

lines.en: : Well, Akira’s very big. And you’re very tiny. So if he did what he wanted to do with you, you might get hurt.
lines.zh: : 嗯,Akira 块头很大。而你非常娇小。所以他若对你做他想做的事,你可能会受伤。

lines.en: : What does he want to do with me? And what are you looking at?
lines.zh: : 他想对我做什么?您在看什么?

lines.en: : Imagine he’s in that locker right now, Tsukasa. How would you feel about him looking at you? Watching you in your current state of undress?
lines.zh: : 想象他此刻就在那个柜子里,Tsukasa。他看着你,你会作何感受?看着你此刻这副未着寸缕的样子?

lines.en: : Right now? Horrible. Who would look at me while you’re here? I can’t be compared to you. That’s so unfair.
lines.zh: : 现在?可怕。您在这里,谁会来看我?我没法和您比。那太不公平了。

lines.en: : But what if he liked you more?...
lines.zh: : 可万一他更喜欢你呢?……

lines.en: : What if the reason he’s struggling so hard when it comes to teaching you is that he feels like he’s not allowed to touch you?...What would you say to him then?
lines.zh: : 万一他每次教你都那么挣扎,是因为他觉得自己不被允许碰你呢?……那时你会对他说什么?

lines.en: : He...doesn’t...though...Jeeves isn’t like that...is he?
lines.zh: : 他……不是……那样……Jeeves 不是那样的人……对吧?

lines.en: : If he is, you won’t think you’re annoying anymore, right? This could all be one big misunderstanding...And he could be in that locker right now jerking off to you, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 他若是,你就不会再觉得自己烦人了,对吧?这可能全是天大的误会……而他此刻也许就在那个柜子里,对着你自我安抚,Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Jerking...off...That...That means...masturbation, correct?
lines.zh: : 自我……安抚……那……那意思是……自慰,对吗?

lines.en: : Correct. How does that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 正确。那让你作何感受?

lines.en: : I...well, I...um...I don’t...um...
: Y...You’re...really close to my ear...Would it be okay for me to sit on the opposite side of the-
lines.zh: : 您……您……离我的耳朵好近……我可以坐到对面的——

lines.en: : Chu...
: HYAAAAAAHHHHHHH?!?!?!?!!!
: Hahaha! Oh, that’s so cute! Your ears are just as sensitive as mine.
lines.zh: : 哈哈!哦,太可爱了!你的耳朵和我的一样敏感。

lines.en: : M-Mother?! Why did you do that?! This is...probably...not acceptable? Maybe? Or...maybe it is?! I...I don’t know! I didn’t like it, though!
lines.zh: : 母-母亲?!您为什么那么做?!这……大概……不太可以?也许?或者……也许可以?!我……我不知道!不过我不喜欢!

lines.en: : Ooooh? But your expression says quite the opposite, dear. I think you loved it.
lines.zh: : 哦————?可你的表情说的恰恰相反,亲爱的。我觉得你爱死了。

lines.en: : I did not! Unless...Unless I was supposed to! I...I need to go do more research!
lines.zh: : 我没有!除非……除非我应该喜欢!我……我需要去查更多资料!

lines.en: : Awww...leaving already? But I freed up my whole afternoon for you, dear.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……这就走了?可我把整个下午都为你空出来了,亲爱的。

lines.en: : Well...I apologize for the inconvenience! But I...I need to go...s...somewhere else!
lines.zh: : 那……很抱歉给您添麻烦!但我……我得去……某……别的地方!

lines.en: : Shall I give Jeeves a call and see if he wants to come give you another lesson today?
lines.zh: : 要不要我给 Jeeves 打个电话,看看他今天想不想来给你再上一课?

lines.en: : No! No, definitely not! He’s big and...and I’m tiny! And that’s...that’s apparently bad! B...
lines.zh: : 不!不,绝对不要!他很大,而……而我很小!而那……那据说很糟!而——

lines.en: : Bye!
: Well, Akira — it appears that-
lines.zh: : 那么,Akira——看来——

lines.en: : Ngh!
: Mnghh!!! Mnghhhh!!!
lines.zh: : 唔嗯!!!唔嗯嗯!!!

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, I suppose I deserved that. Didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 嗯,我想这是我应得的。不是吗?

lines.en: : I...I’m sorry...I was...this is...
lines.zh: : 我……对不起……我刚才……这是……

lines.en: : Oh, no. This is actually quite good. It saves me the effort of having to finish you off myself.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。这其实相当好。省得我亲自动手送你上路了。

lines.en: : You can leave now. I need to go console my daughter in ways less outwardly lascivious. Just don’t say I’ve never done anything for you.
lines.zh: : 你现在可以走了。我得去安慰我女儿——用不那么张扬淫靡的方式。只要别说,我从没为你做过什么。

lines.en: : Tsubasa...why?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……为什么?

lines.en: : Hysterical strength, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : 歇斯底里神力,Aki 君。

lines.en: : Hysterical strength...
lines.zh: : 歇斯底里神力……

lines.en: I’m left to find my way out alone.
lines.zh: 我被留下,独自寻找出去的路。

lines.en: And just like that, every worker bee is back outside of the hive.
lines.zh: 就这样,每一只工蜂又回到了蜂巢之外。

lines.en: They ridicule me for not doing as they do.
lines.zh: 它们嘲笑我不肯像它们那样干活。

lines.en: Little do they know, my shift has already ended.
lines.zh: 它们不知道,我的班次早已结束。

lines.en: And, in other news-
lines.zh: 另外,插播一条新闻——

lines.en: So has the charade.
lines.zh: 那场戏也散场了。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
